text:
maggie: Quick sync — we need a small config/API for routing by customer tier + model-variant fallback and clear quota enforcement modes. My sketch: soft quota (grace window) vs hard quota (reject), plus fallback order of variants per plan. Thoughts?

alex: +1. Important to express per-plan fallback priority and a fallback budget (how many tokens or requests/month can be served on downgraded variants). Also need a signal for when fallback is 'silent' vs 'logged/alert'. :thinking_face:

rahul: Strong +1 for explicit grace window. Example: free plan gets soft quota with 5m grace, then enforces hard for 1m spikes. But for enterprise we should allow pinning to preferred variants (no fallback).

lee: Telemetry note — we must surface three metrics per tenant: fallback_rate, evicted_requests, quota_usage_window. Console should let SRE filter by plan + region and show recent fallbacks (stacked by variant).

sara: Proposed API shape (proto-ish):
```json
{
  "policy_id": "plan-default",
  "rules": [
    {"plan": "free", "quota_mode": "soft", "grace_window_sec": 300, "fallback_order": ["tiny-q8", "tiny-q4"], "fallback_budget_pct": 0.2},
    {"plan": "pro", "quota_mode": "soft", "grace_window_sec": 60, "fallback_order": ["small-q8"], "fallback_budget_pct": 0.05},
    {"plan": "enterprise", "quota_mode": "hard", "fallback_order": []}
  ]
}
```
This keeps it a single resource and easy to version. Would map cleanly to console rows.

maggie: I like single resource. Question: what happens when a tenant has an override? Merge semantics: tenant override should be a delta that can change quota_mode or fallback_order. Are we comfortable with last-writer-wins in API?

alex: Prefer explicit merge: default -> tenant_override applies only keys provided. So tenant only overrides fallback_order, not entire rule unless they supply full rule. Safer.

rahul: We should also allow region-scoped fallbacks. E.g., fall back to regional model variants first, then global. Maybe rule syntax: "fallback_order": ["us-east:small-q8", "global:tiny-q8"].

lee: UX: in console show a heatmap for fallbacks by region and plan, and a small explainer when you toggle hard vs soft quota. Hard quotas should show a sample 429 payload.

ops-bot: policy apply job queued for staging: jobs/3821 — will validate schema and run dry-run.

maggie: Action items: (1) alex & sara to draft final API + tenant-override merge semantics (2) lee to prototype console mockup with telemetry hooks (3) rahul to add region struct to fallback parsing. I'll review by EOD Friday. Thanks! :thumbsup:

alex: noted, will post draft in this thread.

sara: I'll include examples for the SDK and CLI (apply-policy --tenant=acme --patch 'fallback_order=[...]').

maggie: also, let's add an alert rule: if fallback_rate > 10% for >5 minutes for any tenant, page P1. We want to catch silent quality regressions early.

lee: Agree. Add a non-paging warning for <1% so product can see low-level churn.

ops-bot: staging dry-run completed, schema OK, patches: 3 warnings (telemetry labels missing).
